# Content Lessons

This file starts almost empty and grows. After each piece, the Lessons Loop diffs the AI's final draft against the published version, extracts generalizable lessons, and (with approval) logs them here. Lessons override the style guide when they conflict.

## Seed lessons (from known preferences)
- When a claim can be made with a number or a named company, it must be. Adjectives are a fallback only when no specific exists.
- Never open a piece by asserting a common belief in order to knock it down.
- Match length to the ask. A three-sentence answer that's complete beats a padded one.

## Learned lessons
<!-- The system appends here over time. Each entry: date, the change observed, the generalizable rule. -->
- Land the argument with one concrete summary sentence just before the CTA, so the reader arrives at the next step already convinced.
